errors.text_span: показва полезните жилищни площи в квадратни метри, с линейна скала, която обхваща диапазон от 600 до 1500 кв. м,
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the units as "square meters" ("кв. м.") and the range as "600 to 1500 sq. m.". The y-axis label is "ХИЛ. КВ. М.", which means "thousands of square meters". This is a factor of 1000 error in the unit interpretation.

errors.text_span: достига минимум от около 720 кв. м в 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description reports the minimum value in 2015 as approximately 720. However, the data point for 2015 is visibly below the 700 gridline, at a value of approximately 690.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност около 850 кв. м в 2005 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the starting value in 2005 is around 850. The data point is visibly lower than the midpoint between 800 and 900, closer to 830.
The description states the peak in 2009 is around 1410. The data point is almost exactly on the 1400 gridline.
The description reports the value for 2010 as around 1080. The data point is visibly closer to the middle of the 1000-1100 interval, at approximately 1050.

errors.text_span: От 2015 г. до 2018 г. стойностите остават почти постоянни, колебаяйки около 730 кв. м.
errors.evidence: Describing the values from 2015 to 2018 as "almost constant" is an over-generalization. The values are approximately 690 (minimum), 740, 700, and 700. This represents a clear V-shaped trend followed by a flat section, not a period of being almost constant.
